description: Tools and their tests assumed a single run: the tests used the default (latest) run, review pages carried alpha wording, and the alpha's country page linked to index.html after a second run took it.
scaling_implication: Every new run moves index.html and changes the default run, so tests and links must name the run they mean.
recommendation: Keep tests pinned to a named run and add a two-run test fixture before RUN-2026-03.

description: A source already extracted for one run (as a comparator) cannot record a second run's extraction, because an evidence file holds one extraction record.
examples: run_notes 2026-11-03; 11 files in evidence/MDA/; LIM-0026; LIM-0043
scaling_implication: Affects every country with comparator sources from earlier runs (Montenegro, Albania, Serbia, and North Macedonia when used as a comparator).
recommendation: Decide G0-D02 before stage 5; recommended option is an optional earlier_extractions list (evidence schema 1.3).

description: First-pass extractors read only part of long sources (Reform Agenda pages 9 to 26, thesis pages outside the chosen range), so the second pass added 123 items (17 per cent), against a lower share in the alpha.
scaling_implication: Long national and research sources in a new language are where first passes thin out; every country will have them.
recommendation: Brief extractors to screen the whole text before choosing pages, and keep the second pass mandatory for every source.

description: The automatic quote check confirms that a quote occurs in the source but not that it ends on a word boundary, so a quote cut mid-word passed (MDA-GOV-2025-002-0467, with an untrue note that the page text broke there).
scaling_implication: Long national documents in other languages make such cuts more likely and harder for a reviewer to notice.
recommendation: Add a word-boundary check at both ends of the quote to verify_quotes.py (tier 1 tool change).

description: Contradicts links were over-proposed: of 61, an independent check confirmed 8, found 49 apparent (different measures, definitions or reference dates) and 4 not conflicts. Figures that differ because they measure different things were recorded as conflicts.
scaling_implication: Every run with rich national statistics will produce many apparent differences, which crowd out the real conflicts at G5 and in the outputs.
recommendation: In the link brief, propose contradicts only when the two claims concern the same measure at the same date; list other differences in a separate noted-differences file, not as links. Propose as a classification rules clarification at the next gate.

description: Actor records have no field for a successor body and existing rows cannot be edited, so a renamed or merged institution (Bureau for Migration and Asylum and IGM; Ministry of Economy as a former name of ACT-MDA-0004) can only be recorded as a possible duplicate.
scaling_implication: Institutional reorganisations are frequent in every candidate country.
recommendation: Allow a successor or merged_into field on actors (and interventions) set by a superseding note, under rule 7 (IDs never change).

description: Parallel issue-judgement batches proposed the same leads_to link when an intervention served issues in two batches, so four links received two conflicting success and attribution pairs; and claims of absence were checked against different counts of the country's items.
scaling_implication: Every run that splits stage 10 across agents will repeat this unless links are judged once after merging.
recommendation: Judge success and attribution in one pass after the links from all batches are merged (as PC-07 does for taxonomy drafts), and give every batch the run's item count and search scope for PC-09 statements.
cross_refs: judgement rules PC-09, PC-10; classification rules PC-07

description: Shared entities let one run's records leak into another run's outputs: a Moldova comparator link from a North Macedonia intervention appeared in North Macedonia's rebuilt RI-TEC-036 brief, and the G6, G6b and outputs builders read every run's judgements, links and queue rows.
scaling_implication: Every country used as a comparator by a later run would see its signed-off outputs change on rebuild.
recommendation: Scope every builder to the run by run_id (done for build_outputs, G6 and G6b); add a two-run test fixture that rebuilds a closed run after a later run adds records on its entities.

description: Horizontal EU documents (enlargement Communications, Council conclusions) are registered under the first country that used them, so counts, filters, annexes and relevance ratings treated them as that country's documents.
examples: Scaling note S8; writer_problems W2, W3, W4; G4-D15. Recurs in every country.

description: The priority test was read at G6 with a principle the rules do not state (a fulfilled Reform Agenda condition not repeated in the latest report does not alone make an issue High), and the three-report tests rarely apply to a country with few standard reports.
examples: G6-D01, G6-D02, stage10/agent_queries.md. Countries must be judged by the same written test for the regional comparison (scaling note S7).

description: Shared issue definitions drafted from North Macedonia name features that Moldova's evidence does not show, and six shared issues fit Moldova awkwardly; the risk of anchoring grows with each country.
examples: Scaling note S3 and S4; G4-D06; writer_problems W2 and W5.

description: The implementation status scale has no value for a law repealed and replaced by a successor, so 'reversed' was used, which reads as backsliding.
examples: writer_problems W4; INT-MDA-0424, INT-MDA-0428; run_notes stage 10 batch 1.

description: A one-line append opened decision_log.md for writing before reading it and emptied the file; it was committed and pushed before a package test caught it.

Passing G1, G2, G3, G2b and G5b under a standing instruction, with independent agent checks and the PC-16 limits check, and confirming them at the next decision gate, took the run from G0 to G7 in four days without the late discovery seen in the alpha (ALN-0030).
examples: GATE-0015 to GATE-0017, GATE-0026, GATE-0027 confirmed at GATE-0021 and GATE-0028. Keep as a standing lesson for scaling (lesson type worked).
